% Data: speedup.dat, generated by research_tools/package_results.py.
% The axis stops at 60% to keep the quality-relevant region readable; 70% and
% 80% Llama points are reported in Table 1.
\begin{tikzpicture}
\begin{axis}[
  width=\columnwidth, height=0.78\columnwidth,
  xlabel={B8 block sparsity (\%)}, ylabel={Speedup vs.\ Accelerate dense (\%)},
  xmin=5, xmax=62, ymin=-32, ymax=102, xtick={10,20,30,40,50,60},
  grid=major, grid style={gray!20},
  legend pos=north west, legend cell align=left,
  legend style={font=\scriptsize, draw=none, fill=white, fill opacity=0.85},
  tick label style={font=\footnotesize}, label style={font=\small},
  restrict x to domain=0:60, unbounded coords=discard]
\addplot[llama, very thick, mark=*, mark size=1.8pt, mark options={solid, line width=0.4pt},
  error bars/.cd, y dir=both, y explicit]
  table[x=sparsity, y=value,
    y error plus expr=\thisrow{max}-\thisrow{value},
    y error minus expr=\thisrow{value}-\thisrow{min},
    restrict expr to domain={\thisrow{model}}{0:0}] {figures/speedup.dat};
\addlegendentry{Llama, packed B8}
\addplot[tinyllama, very thick, mark=square*, mark size=1.6pt, mark options={solid, line width=0.4pt},
  error bars/.cd, y dir=both, y explicit]
  table[x=sparsity, y=value,
    y error plus expr=\thisrow{max}-\thisrow{value},
    y error minus expr=\thisrow{value}-\thisrow{min},
    restrict expr to domain={\thisrow{model}}{1:1}] {figures/speedup.dat};
\addlegendentry{TinyLlama, packed B8}
\addplot[llama, thick, densely dashed, mark=o, mark size=1.8pt, mark options={solid},
  error bars/.cd, y dir=both, y explicit]
  table[x=sparsity, y=neuron,
    y error plus expr=\thisrow{neuronmax}-\thisrow{neuron},
    y error minus expr=\thisrow{neuron}-\thisrow{neuronmin},
    restrict expr to domain={\thisrow{model}}{0:0}] {figures/speedup.dat};
\addlegendentry{Llama, per-neuron}
\addplot[tinyllama, thick, densely dashed, mark=square, mark size=1.6pt, mark options={solid},
  error bars/.cd, y dir=both, y explicit]
  table[x=sparsity, y=neuron,
    y error plus expr=\thisrow{neuronmax}-\thisrow{neuron},
    y error minus expr=\thisrow{neuron}-\thisrow{neuronmin},
    restrict expr to domain={\thisrow{model}}{1:1}] {figures/speedup.dat};
\addlegendentry{TinyLlama, per-neuron}
\addplot[black, thin, domain=5:62] {0};
\end{axis}
\end{tikzpicture}
